gaps.explanation: Statement lines are the accrual Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6, Total column): Metered sales 1,350,957 + Capital connection fee 162,515 + Assessments 36,105 + Rent 290,726 + Other miscellaneous 13,993 + Unreconcilable income 541,267 + Interest income 6,089 = 2,401,652 (printed Total operating revenues 2,395,564 + interest income 6,089 = 2,401,653; 1 rounding in the printed total). The detail is the BUDGETARY-basis Proprietary Funds budget schedule (p9), printed Total receipts 2,913,718 less Transfers from other funds 509,126 = 2,404,592. The whole 2,940 is on one row: p9 'Water and wastewater billings' 1,516,412 vs p6 Metered sales 1,350,957 + Capital connection fee 162,515 = 1,513,472; difference 2,940 = the '(In)decrease in accounts receivable 2,940' printed on the proprietary cash flow statement p7 (collections vs accrual billings). All other rows agree (Rent 290,726, Interest 6,089, Assessments 36,105, Other 13,993, Unreconcilable income 541,267). 2,404,592 - 2,401,652 = 2,940. No fix: both printed figures are correct on their own basis.

Statement total 2,122,171 = accrual Total operating expenses 1,972,606 + Interest expense 149,565 (p6 Total column; also Statement of Activities total business-type expenses p2). The detail is the budgetary-basis Proprietary Funds schedule p9, printed 'Total proprietary disbursements' 2,171,211 (lines: Water Personal services 43,713 + Operating 1,142,057 + Supplies 42,353 + Capital purchases 161,478 + Debt service 638,511 + Nursing home Debt service 143,100 = 2,171,212; 1 rounding in the printed total). Reconciliation: (a) budgetary Debt service 638,511 + 143,100 = 781,611 = p7 principal paid 632,046 + interest 149,565, so the schedule carries principal 632,046 that the accrual statement does not; (b) the accrual statement carries Depreciation 362,354 (p6) that the budgetary schedule does not; (c) remaining operating costs: accrual 1,972,606 - 362,354 = 1,610,252 vs budgetary 43,713 + 1,142,057 + 42,353 + 161,478 = 1,389,601, i.e. 220,651 lower on the budgetary basis (budget-basis timing/classification; the schedule does not itemize it). 632,046 - 362,354 - 220,651 = 49,041 = 2,171,212 - 2,122,171. No fix: two printed totals on different bases (p9 budgetary 2,171,211; p6 accrual 1,972,606 + 149,565 = 2,122,171).
